name: Hyoka – Customer Reviews, Product Reviews, Photo & Video UGC & Loyalty for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Shoppers don’t trust product descriptions. They trust other shoppers.

Before someone buys from your WooCommerce store, they’re checking for proof: star ratings, real photos, an honest review, maybe an answer to a question they had before checkout. If your product pages don’t show that proof, they’ll go find it on a competitor’s site instead.

Hyoka is a WooCommerce reviews plugin that collects customer reviews, photo and video UGC, product Q&A, and loyalty rewards — all inside your own WordPress dashboard. It’s 100% native, not a SaaS tool, so there’s no monthly subscription, no cap on how many reviews you can collect, and your review data never leaves your own server.

Visit the Hyoka website for a full product overview, browse the complete feature list, or check pricing and plans if you’re ready to unlock Pro features.

What Hyoka Does For Your Store

  • Collects product reviews with star ratings — on the product page or through a simple review form.
  • Lets customers upload photo and video reviews — real unboxing pictures and video clips, straight from a phone.
  • Displays reviews using storefront widgets — review boxes, video grids, sliders, and testimonial displays that match your theme.
  • Sends automated review request emails — after an order is marked complete, or manually whenever you choose.
  • Uses built-in AI to save you time — sentiment detection, auto-generated reply drafts, review summaries, and spam filtering.
  • Rewards customers with coupons and referrals — automatic discount codes for reviewing, plus shareable referral links.
  • Runs a dedicated Q&A section on product pages — shoppers ask, you (or your community) answer.
  • Imports and exports reviews in one click — move data in from CSV, Judge.me, or Yotpo without losing history.

How Automated Review Request Emails Work

You don’t need to manually ask every customer for a review. Hyoka does it for you in four steps:

  1. A customer places an order in your WooCommerce store.
  2. You mark the order as complete once it ships.
  3. After the number of days you set, Hyoka automatically emails the customer asking for a review.
  4. The customer rates the product, writes feedback, and uploads photos or video — all in one simple form.

Store managers also get:

  • One review form covering every item from a single order.
  • Manual review invite emails for specific orders.
  • Emails automatically personalized with the customer’s name and order details.
  • An email design editor to match your store’s colors and branding.
  • Test sends, so you can preview exactly what customers receive.
  • Open and click tracking on every review request email.
  • A follow-up email asking specifically for photos or video after a review is submitted.
  • A second reminder email for customers who missed the first one.
  • Automatic thank-you emails when a review comes in, and reply notifications.

Why Product Reviews Increase WooCommerce Sales

A shopper who sees real reviews, ratings, and customer photos is far more likely to buy than one who sees a product page with none. Reviews answer the questions a product description can’t: does this actually work, is this store trustworthy, did anyone else have a good experience.

Hyoka builds that trust with:

  • Photo reviews — real product photos from customers, not stock images.
  • Video reviews — short customer video clips showing the product in use.
  • AI sentiment analysis — automatically tags each review as positive, neutral, or negative.
  • AI smart replies — draft a professional response to any review in seconds.
  • AI review summaries — long reviews condensed into a few clear points.
  • Trust badges — a snapshot of your store’s review reputation, shown anywhere on your site.
  • Site-wide rating widget — your overall store rating, displayed wherever you need it.
  • Review filtering and sorting — by star rating, date, or most helpful.
  • Reader voting and reply threads — shoppers can vote on helpful reviews and discuss them.
  • Verified purchase badges — shows which reviewers actually bought the product.
  • Lightweight, conditional script loading — review widgets don’t slow down your store.

How Hyoka Helps With WooCommerce SEO

Every new review, photo, and video is fresh content on your product page — and fresh, unique content is exactly what search engines reward.

Hyoka also adds:

  • Unique, keyword-rich content written in your customers’ own words.
  • Real user-generated photos and video that a static product page can’t produce alone.
  • JSON-LD structured data, so your star ratings can appear directly in Google search results.
  • Enhanced search snippets, giving shoppers more reason to click your listing over a competitor’s.

Customer Q&A: Answer Questions Before They Cause Abandoned Carts

A shopper with an unanswered question rarely checks out — they leave the tab open and go compare, or they simply leave. A visible Q&A section on the product page closes that gap.

Included with Q&A:

  • A dedicated Q&A tab on every product page.
  • Automatic email notifications when a question is answered.
  • Threaded replies, so buyers can respond to each other.
  • Spam protection and keyword filtering to keep questions on-topic.
  • A full activity log of every review and Q&A update.

Loyalty Rewards and Referral Program

Getting a customer to buy again is far cheaper than finding a new one. Hyoka turns every review into a reason for a customer to come back:

  • Automatic coupon rewards when a customer submits a review.
  • Fair reward rules — coupons are earned for leaving a review, not just a positive one, which keeps every review honest.
  • Discount codes emailed automatically right after a review is submitted.
  • A referral program so customers can share their own referral link with friends.
  • Coupon expiry reminder emails that create urgency to use the reward.

Import and Export Reviews

Switching from another review platform shouldn’t mean losing years of star ratings and customer photos.

  • Import and export product and store reviews.
  • Import and export reviews that include photo and video attachments.
  • One-click import support for Judge.me and Yotpo export files.
  • Import and export customer questions and answers.

Want the full breakdown before you install? See everything Hyoka does on the features page, or compare plans on the pricing page.

Blocks

This plugin provides 3 optimized blocks for easy visual placement:

  • Reviews Grid: A clean grid layout of product and store reviews.
  • Trust Badge: A summary badge of product and store reviews, placeable anywhere on your site.
  • Reviews Slider: A smooth, swipeable slider of top customer testimonials and media.
sections.installation:
Minimum System Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3 or higher
  • WooCommerce 4.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for “Hyoka”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  5. Select Hyoka from your admin menu to configure your settings.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from your account.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and go to Hyoka in your admin menu.
sections.faq:
Is Hyoka a SaaS platform or a native WordPress plugin?

Hyoka is a fully native WordPress and WooCommerce plugin. Your review data stays on your own server — there’s no monthly subscription and no limit on how many reviews you can collect.

Can I migrate my existing reviews from Judge.me, Yotpo, or CSV?

Yes. Hyoka’s importer brings in past reviews from CSV spreadsheets, Judge.me, or Yotpo exports, keeping your star ratings, dates, and photos or video intact.

How do automated review request emails work?

Once an order is marked “Completed” in WooCommerce, Hyoka waits the number of days you’ve set, then emails the customer a direct link to a mobile-friendly review form. No manual follow-up needed.

Does the AI review assistant cost extra?

No. AI sentiment analysis, smart reply drafts, and spam filtering are all built into your WordPress dashboard at no separate cost. Some advanced AI and moderation tools are part of Pro — see pricing and plans for the full breakdown.

Will Hyoka slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Review scripts load only on the pages where review widgets actually appear, so the rest of your store — including checkout — stays fast.

Do customers get a coupon even if they leave a negative review?

Yes. Coupon rewards are given for submitting a review, not for a specific star rating. Rewarding only positive reviews would make the whole review system less trustworthy — so Hyoka rewards honesty instead.
